name: Aihara Ringo
source:
An energetic, aspiring young girl. A first-year student in nursing school and graduate of St. Michael’s.  A hardworker who always maintains excellent grades.
 
She’s family friends with Chiaki, who is a nurse and teacher, and has admired her since they were little.
 Taking her acceptance to nursing school as an opportunity to become independent from her parents, she’s begun living with Chiaki in her apartment.

[[url=http://petalsgarden.axypb.net/2013/03/22/yurin-yurin-official-website-3/]Translated[/url] from [url=http://gyutto.com/i/item104653]Gyutto[/url] and [url=http://www.yurinyurin.com/tenshinoakogare/character.html]Yurin Yurin[/url]]
